_comment: Pre-op assessment checklist for the missingness check in backend/retrieve.py. Code sets are copied verbatim from the matching concept rows in data/synonyms.csv -- corpus-derived, already vetted for NER matching -- not invented here. Extend only by pointing at another synonyms.csv concept (or several, unioned) plus a codes-derived from data/expected_facts.json review. window_days is a placeholder clinical default (90 days for labs), not a measured value -- revisit with real guidance.
